question: What is the package cost?
answer: The cost depends on your chosen trip, travel date, group size, vehicle and accommodation preference. Send these details to Heavenly Tours & Travels on WhatsApp. Owner Hemanth Kumar will share a quotation and explain what is included before you confirm your booking.

question: What is the Tirumala package cost?
answer: Tirumala trip costs are confirmed individually for your travel date, pickup point, number of travellers, vehicle and hotel preference. Tell the owner what you need on WhatsApp to receive a quote. Darshan ticket guidance does not include booking tickets or guaranteeing official availability.

question: Are all the listed temples covered?
answer: The Complete 7-Temple Trip covers all seven temples listed on its trip page. Individual and day-wise trips follow their own listed stops. Before booking, ask the owner to confirm your selected route, visit order, dates and arrangements, since temple timings and access can affect travel.

question: How many temples are covered?
answer: Our Complete 7-Temple Trip includes seven temples. Other trips cover different temple routes, shown on each trip page or in its day-by-day plan. Choose the trip you prefer, then confirm its stops with the owner on WhatsApp before agreeing to the booking.

question: What types of cars do you have?
answer: Our vehicle choices are Maruti S-Cross, Innova Crysta, Innova, Ertiga, Tempo Traveller, Toyota Etios and Swift Dzire. Driver-operated and self-drive car rentals are also available. Share your date, group size and luggage needs on WhatsApp so the owner can confirm the suitable vehicle, seating and rental terms.
